summary: WebRender received a broad set of rendering-quality and compositor improvements. It now tracks device-space coverage and visibility more precisely for text, gradients, borders, box shadows, backdrop-filter effects, perspective surfaces, and cached tiles, while adding CSS corner-shape superellipses and improving glyph scaling and positioning. Better shader diagnostics, retained test resources, new wrench reftests, and clearer culling instrumentation should make GPU rendering issues easier to detect and debug.
